sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me try a systematic approach. I'll explore different character positions
# and see if any combination leads to level completion.

# First, let me understand the current character position and the red block positions
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Find character
char_node = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 135][0]
char_center = (sum(p[0] for p in char_node['boundary']) // len(char_node['boundary']),
               sum(p[1] for p in char_node['boundary']) // len(char_node['boundary']))
print(f"Character center: {char_center}")

# Find red blocks
red_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'R']
print(f"Red blocks: {len(red_nodes)}")
for r in red_nodes:
    r_center = (sum(p[0] for p in r['boundary']) // len(r['boundary']),
                sum(p[1] for p in r['boundary']) // len(r['boundary']))
    print(f"  at {r_center}, boundary={r['boundary']}")

# Try moving the character UP and LEFT to return towards initial position
# Then try SPACE at different positions
result = action(['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])
print(f"\nAfter LEFTx5: done={last_action_result.get('done')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
char_node = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W' and n['pixels'] == 135][0]
char_center = (sum(p[0] for p in char_node['boundary']) // len(char_node['boundary']),
               sum(p[1] for p in char_node['boundary']) // len(char_node['boundary']))
print(f"Character center: {char_center}")

red_count = sum(1 for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'R')
print(f"Red blocks: {red_count}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
